dashboard.name: NutsNews Backend - APM - External Dependencies
dashboard.description: 24 hour dashboard for outbound dependency count, latency, error rate, slow hosts, and transaction contribution. Managed from ramideltoro/nutsnews-backend.

pages.name: Outbound dependencies
pages.description: Outbound HTTP and third-party dependency behavior from backend APM spans.

nrqlQueries.query: SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND category IN ('external', 'http') TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(duration), percentile(duration, 95), max(duration) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND category IN ('external', 'http') TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT count(*) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND category IN ('external', 'http') AND error IS true TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

SELECT percentile(duration, 95), average(duration), count(*) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND category IN ('external', 'http') FACET peer.hostname LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT percentile(duration, 95), count(*) FROM Span WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' AND category IN ('external', 'http') FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(externalDuration), average(duration), count(*) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' FACET name LIMIT 10 SINCE 24 hours ago
SELECT average(externalDuration), average(duration) FROM Transaction WHERE appName = 'nutsnews-backend-production' TIMESERIES SINCE 24 hours ago

rawConfiguration.text: Start with host-level p95, then inspect the transaction contribution panel. Keep facets bounded to host and operation names.
